records.prompt: Create a TRUE TRANSPARENT 2x2 sprite sheet of FOUR DIFFERENT default AshenSpire characters, reference images provided: top left Reaver in red cape steel helmet armor, top right Starseer dark blue starry robes hood and brass scroll tubes, bottom left Herald rust-red hood gold cross embroidered brown robes book at belt, bottom right Rogue teal torn cape brown hood leather armor. Match exact painted dark fantasy identity and costume from references. EACH cell has one complete full-body rear three-quarter RIGHT-facing sprite preparing a SPEAR THRUST. Spear is a long wooden shaft with exactly ONE steel spearhead on its RIGHT END and a blunt wooden LEFT END. Hold spear horizontally at waist height in TWO HANDS visibly separated: right hand grips rear shaft by right hip, left hand grips front shaft near chest. Both hands MUST visible clasp same continuous shaft. Spear tip points RIGHT, upper body coiled slightly back, knees bent and feet grounded. NOT overhead, not throwing, not double-ended, not halberd, no shield or sword. Generous transparent margin all sides, entire figure and entire spear fully visible. No labels, text, lines, scenery, background or drop shadow. This is four anticipation replacement frames, NOT full sequences. Preserve rear three-quarter view and realistic proportions.

Paint a transparent 2x2 character sprite sheet with FOUR sprites: Reaver top left, Starseer top right, Herald bottom left, Rogue bottom right, matching attached default appearance references exactly. Full-body rear three-quarter view facing RIGHT, back to camera; painterly realistic dark fantasy. All four are preparing SWORD AND SHIELD attack. RIGHT ARM nearest viewer bends in front of chest, right hand holds steel arming sword near RIGHT shoulder, blade points diagonally UP AND RIGHT in front of character. LEFT ARM on far side holds round wood/steel shield in front of torso, visible as partial shield beyond right silhouette. The sword must remain in the near right hand; NEVER place sword in far left arm raised behind head. No overhead gesture. Both boots grounded, knees bent, torso winding slightly back. One sword, one shield, exactly two arms, consistent canonical costume. Entire weapons within image and ample transparent margins. No text or grid. This is ONLY four anticipation frames, no other phases.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production sprite animation sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, 2048x2048 square, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal 512 square cells. No text, gridlines, scenery, shadows or labels. Each cell contains one complete full-body painted sprite, with generous empty margins; nothing crosses a cell boundary. Canonical identity references attached in row order: row 1 Reaver (closed steel helmet, battered plate and long torn RED cape), row 2 Starseer (dark blue hood and torn star-patterned robe, brass scroll tubes), row 3 Herald (rust-red hood, brown clerical tattered robes, gold cross embroidery and belt book), row 4 Rogue (brown hood leather armor and torn dark TEAL cape). These are identity/style references, not edit targets. Preserve their realistic painterly dark-fantasy style and correct anatomy. All face right away from viewer, rear three-quarter view, back dominant, opponent offscreen right. Do not show frontal faces. Every row is a distinct FOUR-FRAME attack with that same character and same specified weapon: columns anticipation, strike/release, follow-through, recovery. Paint truly different limb/body poses, no mere translated or rotated duplicates. Two arms and two legs each, natural joints, grounded boots. Approximately 330 pixel standing body height per cell with foot baseline y=465 within each cell. Consistent body scale, fixed camera. Weapons may use remaining margin but must fit fully. Maintain recognizable costume in every frame. Hide non-used original held weapons; preserve outfit accessories. No other characters. Weapon and hands must contact correctly.
CRITICAL WEAPON FAMILY: GREAT SWORD. This must be unmistakably different from a one-handed arming sword. EXTRA BROAD HUGE BLADE, large crossguard and LONG grip about 35 cm. BOTH HANDS must visibly wrap hilt with a visible GAP between gauntlets, right hand just below guard and left hand by pommel. Both forearms visible and converging in front of chest in ALL frames, NOT hidden under cape. Keep body rear three-quarter right, turn shoulders just enough to show TWO forearms. NO hand free, NO shield. Column1: two-handed chest-level coiled guard sword sloping up-right, with left elbow jutting left. Column2: both hands together forward-right at chest-level performing a greatsword cut, long wide blade points upper-right. Column3: low follow-through both separated hand grips visible below waist blade sloping down-right. Column4: two-handed middle guard with broad blade pointing diagonally right. All four phases distinct. No overhead blade, no weapon beyond canvas, keep empty gutters. Prioritize clearly painted two hands on long hilt and large blade weight over decorative details.
